title: Her Little Fern
lines: Pam has a little fern in a pot.
She sets her fern on the top step.
Then a herd of big pigs runs past.
The pigs bump her fern off the step.
Her fern lands flat in the mud.
Dad helps her fill the pot back up.
She pats the mud in with her hands.
Pam sets her fern up on the table.

questions.ask: What knocked the fern off the step?
questions.listenFor: The herd of big pigs running past. If they say 'the pigs,' ask how many.

questions.ask: How did Pam and Dad fix the fern?
questions.listenFor: Dad filled the pot back up and Pam patted the mud in. Listen for both of them.

questions.ask: Why do you think Pam put the fern on the table?
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The pigs cannot reach it up there.
